revenue.source: Pfizer 10-K FY2024 (acc. 0000078003-25-000054) Financial_Report for 2023/2024 revenue; FY2025 10-K (acc. 0000078003-26-000026) / Q4-2025 earnings release for 2025 ($62,579m)

operating_income.source: stockanalysis.com income statement 'Operating Income' (Pfizer reports no operating income line; this vendor figure appears to exclude other (income)/deductions such as impairments, so it exceeds pretax income of 1,058/8,023/7,521). Reviewer should verify definition vs 10-K.

d_and_a.source: Pfizer FY2025 10-K (acc. 0000078003-26-000026) consolidated cash flow statement, Depreciation and amortization

capex.source: Pfizer FY2025 10-K (acc. 0000078003-26-000026) cash flow statement, Purchases of property, plant and equipment

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 revenue fell 2%; Pfizer faces material loss-of-exclusivity erosion through ~2028 (Eliquis, Ibrance, Prevnar, Xtandi etc.) and COVID product decline, offset by Seagen/Metsera pipeline growth; gradual return to low growth. Not company guidance.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: below FY2025 vendor-defined margin of 30.6% (19,164/62,579) and FY2024 24.5%; reflects revenue pressure from LOE, continued R&D investment and amortization, partly offset by cost-realignment savings.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximate normalized effective tax rate for Pfizer's global mix (low-to-mid teens adjusted rate); GAAP rate volatile (FY2025 tax benefit).

da_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 D&A 6,592/62,579 = 10.5%; FY2024 11.0%; assume slight decline as intangibles amortize.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM with beta ~0.6, rf ~4.2%, ERP ~5%, cost of equity ~7.5-8%, after-tax debt cost ~4%, debt-heavy mix (~$65bn debt) gives ~7%; rounded up to 7.5% for LOE risk.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run inflation/GDP given mature, patent-cliff-exposed portfolio.

net_debt.source: Pfizer FY2025 annual report (pfe-ars2026.pdf) balance sheet: short-term borrowings 3,154 + long-term debt 61,641 = 64,795, less cash 1,142 and short-term investments 12,454 (excludes leases and long-term investments).

diluted_shares.source: FY2025 full-year weighted-average diluted shares not found in search results; 5,708m is the six-months-ended Jun 2025 weighted diluted figure from Pfizer 10-Q/Q2 2026 release. Reviewer should replace with the 10-K figure.
